name: Shifty Eyes
description: A face made with emojis showing suspicious or flirty sidelong glances, often used for gossip or intrigue.
meaning: Used to express interest, suspicion, or that something tea-worthy is happening. Can be flirty or gossipy depending on context.
examples: Did you see what she posted 👀👄👀
seoDescription: What does 👀👄👀 mean? The eyes and lips emoji combo explained. Used for gossip, intrigue, or flirty attention.
